testimonies.testimony: Yer right. It was a cold night, and the mist was thick as grits.
So, once I was finished setting up my camera, I got back in the car.
Still, I brought my binoculars with me.
The camera was set up to take pictures of a meteor shower.

source.testimony_span: The camera was set up to take pictures of a meteor shower.
source.explanation: A camera to shoot the stars would not be pointing towards the lake.

testimonies.testimony: When I heard that noise out on the lake, I looked with my binoculars.

turns.summarizedContext: Lotta is describing what she saw on the lake the night of the crime.
reasoning: Fact 1: The witness claims the camera is for taking pictures of a meteor shower.
Fact 2: The evidence suggests the camera is facing the lake.
Prop 1: If one wants to take pictures of a meteor shower, the camera should be facing the sky.
